stem: Two rooms run the same clock irrigation schedule, but one has higher PPFD, larger plants and faster measured dryback. What is the best conclusion?
choices: Clock schedules should remain identical regardless of demand
Scheduling should be evaluated from root-zone response and crop demand, not copied solely by time
The room with faster dryback must have lower light
Dryback is unrelated to crop size
rationale: Irrigation scheduling is feedback-driven and should respond to actual root-zone and crop-demand evidence.
